sentences.text: Sea-blue histiocyte syndrome is linked to the gene APOE in curated databases [e_8e5e20f68208].
No gene is listed for glycoprotein storage disease in these edges [e_2d725422cc40].
For glycoprotein storage disease, gout is listed with a low confidence of 0.5 [e_2d725422cc40].
Constellate computed a weak similarity between the two diseases in their listed symptoms, with a score of 0.142 [e_87463e896c63].
That score is inferred and rests on 1 shared term, an enlarged spleen [e_87463e896c63].
So these edges do not show that the two diseases are closely related [e_87463e896c63].
They also show no trials, funding or patient groups for either disease [e_8e5e20f68208].
